subject: Coordinating keystore transfer, phased backup purge, and EU log retention waiver
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medivault.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.example>
Cc: Anne Laurent <anne.laurent@medivault.com>, audit+legal@medivault.com
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Urgent - EU purge window and temporary keystore custodian

Connor —

Thanks for taking this. We have an upcoming regulator spot check in the Netherlands and need to temporarily move a subset of encryption key custody to our EU subprocessor for on‑prem failover testing. That triggers two asks from our side:

1) A short variance to the log retention for the affected shard (we need +14 days on the forensic log stream during the window).
2) A documented key handover checklist and evidence trail proving the subprocessor never had unrestricted access outside the scoped timeframe.

Can Redwood provide a proposed timeline for the backup purge (we need to ensure backups that are scheduled for the same week are not purged mid‑handover) and a keystore handover checklist we can include in the audit packet?

We also need the DPA addendum signed (I attached a draft to the DocuSign link you provided earlier; can we get an internal owner to coordinate)?

Thanks — Priya
Director, Legal & Compliance
Medivault

---
Attachments referenced: none (DocuSign link provided)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.example>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medivault.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Urgent - EU purge window and temporary keystore custodian

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the clear asks. Internal owners copied. High level proposal:

- Phased purge pause: We can place a hold on scheduled backup purges for the affected shard starting 2027-12-01 00:00 UTC through 2027-12-07 23:59 UTC. (This gives a 7‑day buffer around the handover.)
- Log retention offset: Redwood can enable a +14 day retention on the forensic log stream for that shard for the same window; logs will be marked as "audit-preserve" and excluded from auto‑prune jobs.
- Keystore handover: Attached is a working checklist (key-handover-checklist.xlsx). We propose the subprocessor will operate as a "custodian" under strict KMS‑wrapped key escrow — no plaintext export.
- Evidence & artifacts: We'll compile KMS access logs, KMIP session records, and an HSM audit export for the handover period.
- DPA addendum / DocuSign: Kimberly, can your team confirm the DPA addendum language and trigger DocuSign? I will send a mutual action plan and the backup timeline CSV once legal confirms acceptance.

Next steps: Kimberly to confirm the legal language; Laura to publish the internal ops runbook and schedule the hold; Jonas to prepare the KMS audit export. I will coordinate timing with Priya so Medivault can schedule their on‑prem test.

Connor O'Brien
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: key-handover-checklist.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.example>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medivault.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Urgent - EU purge window and temporary keystore custodian

Thanks, Connor. Priya — quick legal notes:

- We can sign a narrowly scoped DPA addendum that covers the 7‑day custody window and the specific shard IDs you provided (please confirm shard list). We will not consent to permanent key transfer.
- Required evidence: Medivault must accept a scoped access log package (KMS event stream, HSM txn IDs) and a signed attestation from the subprocessor confirming: (a) no off‑window exports, (b) single purpose only for failover testing, and (c) deletion of any temporary session keys post‑window.
- Audit deliverables: DocuSign link provided by Connor should have the latest PDF attached (DocuSign_DPA_v3.pdf). I will redline once I have the exact shard identifiers.

Connor — please prepare the backup-purge-timeline.csv with the exact schedules for any affected snapshot jobs and the list of shard IDs. Laura, I'll need a short blurb we can include in the addendum about our rollback procedure in case of a premature purge.

Kimberly Park
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: DocuSign_DPA_v3.pdf

From: Anne Laurent <anne.laurent@medivault.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.example>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medivault.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 08:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Urgent - EU purge window and temporary keystore custodian

Connor/Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming the shard list: mv-eu-logs-11, mv-eu-logs-12. We accept the 7‑day custody window you proposed (2027-12-01 to 2027-12-07) conditional on receipt of the following before 2027-11-30 EOD: 

1) backup-purge-timeline.csv (exact snapshot job IDs and retention thresholds),
2) key-handover-checklist.xlsx with step owners and time-of-day windows, and
3) an explicit rollback playbook that Redwood ops will execute if the purge scheduler triggers mid‑handover.

We are attaching Medivault's SOC2 excerpt in this thread (reference only); we will provide a signed attestation from our subprocessor once the checklist is finalized.

Anne Laurent
Security Operations, Medivault

---
Attachment: Medivault_SOC2_excerpt.pdf (referenced)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.example>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medivault.com>, Anne Laurent <anne.laurent@medivault.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 16:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Urgent - EU purge window and temporary keystore custodian — M.A.P. & artifacts

All —

Action summary and owners (final):

- Redwood will pause purge jobs for shards mv-eu-logs-11 and mv-eu-logs-12 from 2027-12-01T00:00Z through 2027-12-07T23:59Z. Owner: Laura Bennett.
- Redwood will enable +14 day retention flag (audit-preserve) for the forensic stream during the window. Owner: Jonas Weber.
- Redwood will provide KMS/HSM audit exports (KMIP txns, KMS event IDs) within 48 hours after window close. Owner: Jonas Weber.
- Redwood ops will publish a rollback playbook (include lockfile pattern and emergency snapshot restore steps) and notify Medivault 2 hours prior to any scheduler restart. Owner: Laura Bennett.
- Legal: Kimberly will finalize and send DocuSign addendum (DocuSign_DPA_v3.pdf). Please sign by 2027-12-01 18:00 UTC so we can proceed.

Attachments: backup-purge-timeline.csv (contains snapshot job IDs: snap-8873, snap-8874 and scheduled purge times), key-handover-checklist.xlsx. DocuSign link: https://app.redwood.example/docsign/abc123

Priya/Anne — please confirm once signed and when your subprocessor can provide the attestation. We'll stage the artifacts in the shared drive link above for your audit packet.

Connor O'Brien
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: backup-purge-timeline.csv, key-handover-checklist.xlsx
